UZL3: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay & Dho-Padhay:
Rag Gauri Guareri, 1st Guru, Chaupade Dupde.
EDM5: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
There is but one God. True is His Name, Creative His personality and Immortal His form. He is without fear, without enmity, unborn and self-illumined. By Guru's favour He is obtained.
UWH7: The Fear of God is overpowering, and so very heavy,
Lord's fear is very great and very heavy.
5A4X: while the intellect is lightweight, as is the speech one speaks.
Paltry is man's intellect and the speech, that he delivers.
YK3C: So place the Fear of God upon your head, and bear that weight;
Walk by placing Lord's fear on your head, and bear the weight of it.
4H91: by the Grace of the Merciful Lord, contemplate the Guru. ||1||
He, on whom is the grace, of the Merciful, through the Guru, meditates on Him.
GUGE: Without the Fear of God, no one crosses over the world-ocean.
Without Lord's fear none can cross the world-ocean.
YXFR: This Fear of God adorns the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Lord's fear and dread bedecks man's love for Him. Pause.
UPCQ: The fire of fear within the body is burnt away by the Fear of God.
The body's fire of fear is burnt away by the dread of God.
NNFS: Through this Fear of God, we are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.
With Lord's fear and fright, man's speech is fashioned and decorated.
TQL7: Without the Fear of God, all that is fashioned is false.
What is fashioned without Lord's fear is altogether worthless.
FM95: Useless is the mold, and useless are the hammer-strokes on the mold. ||2||
Useless is the mould and useless the stroke thereon.
RTS8: The desire for the worldly drama arises in the intellect,
The desire for worldly plays arises in man's intellect.
GGZZ: but even with thousands of clever mental tricks, the heat of the Fear of God does not come into play.
Inspite of thousands of clevernesses, the heat of Lord's fear comes not to play.
GZTE: O Nanak, the speech of the self-willed manmukh is just wind.
Nanak, the speech of an apostate is nonsense,
LU4E: His words are worthless and empty, like the wind. ||3||1||
and worthless & absurd is his preaching.
M95U: Place the Fear of God within the home of your heart; with this Fear of God in your heart, all other fears shall be frightened away.
Place God's fear in your heart, and let your home be in His dread. Your fear of Death, then shall be frightened away.
GBFJ: What sort of fear is that, which frightens other fears?
What sort of fear is that, by which the fear of death is frightened?
RG90: Without You, I have other place of rest at all.
Without You, there is no other place of rest.
PP03: Whatever happens is all according to Your Will. ||1||
Whatsoever happens, is all according to Your will.
Y1J7: Be afraid, if you have any fear, other than the Fear of God.
Fear, if we have any other fear than that of the Lord.
JKJ5: Afraid of fear, and living in fear, the mind is held in tumult. ||1||Pause||
To be awed with fear, other than the fear of God, is but mind's tumult. Pause.
0W8Q: The soul does not die; it does not drown, and it does not swim across.
By itself the soul dies not, neither it is drowned, nor swims across.
9G6X: The One who created everything does everything.
He, Who did make the creation, does everything.
ETB0: By the Hukam of His Command we come, and by the Hukam of His Command we go.
By Lord's order man comes, and by His order he goes.
8DY6: Before and after, His Command is pervading. ||2||
Before and after this birth, as well, the mortal remain absorbed in His fiat.
6NET: In whom there is cruelty, worldly love, desire, and egotism,
YCUK: there is great hunger in these, like the raging torrent of a wild stream.
in them, like the water of a stream, there is a great hunger.
ZW6Z: Let the Fear of God be your food, drink and support.
For the Guruwards, Lord's fear is the food, drink, and main-stay.
BWC0: Without doing this, the fools simply die. ||3||
Without entertaining Lord's fear the fools perish away.
SH6W: If anyone really has anyone else - how rare is that person!
If mortal has someone as his own then that some one is very rare indeed.
EAA1: All are Yours - You are the Lord of all.
All are Yours, and you, O sublime Lord are of all.
YC8H: All beings and creatures, wealth and property belong to Him.
To whom belong all living beings, wealth and property,
Y07K: O Nanak, it is so difficult to describe and contemplate Him. ||4||2||
Nanak, it is not easy to describe and explain Him.
2JQ2: Let wisdom be your mother, and contentment your father.
I consider wisdom as my mother, contentment as my father,
45RQ: Let Truth be your brother - these are your best relatives. ||1||
and truthfulness as my brother. These are my good relations.
MPAK: He has been described, but He cannot be described at all.
People describe Him, but he cannot be described, in the least.
CD00: Your All-pervading creative nature cannot be estimated. ||1||Pause||
Yours omnipotence, O Master cannot be appraised. Pause.

RZDA: Modesty, humility and intuitive understanding are my mother-in-law and father-in-law;
Modesty and understanding have become two parents-in-law.
94UP: I have made good deeds my spouse. ||2||
Good deeds I have made and accepted as my wife.
PQMW: Union with the Holy is my wedding date, and separation from the world is my marriage.
Union with saints is my time of wedding, and separation from the world my marriage.
0GD1: Says Nanak, Truth is the child born of this Union. ||3||3||
Says Nanak, from such a union has sprung truth as my off-spring.
XVVX: The union of air, water and fire
The body is the union of air water and fire.
5V1X: the body is the play-thing of the fickle and unsteady intellect.
It is the plaything of the fickle and unsteady mind.
8HG0: It has nine doors, and then there is the Tenth Gate.
It has nine door, and tenth the gate,
N7B2: Reflect upon this and understand it, O wise one. ||1||
O theologian understand and reflect on this.
VFWJ: The Lord is the One who speaks, teaches and listens.
That Lord is the utterer, speaker and the listener.
M8CJ: One who contemplates his own self is truly wise. ||1||Pause||
He, who reflect upon his own-self is the knower of God. Pause.
0R4U: The body is dust; the wind speaks through it.
The body is the dust, and the wind speaks therein.
7F3M: Understand, O wise one, who has died.
Consider, O wise-man, who it is that has died.
MRFL: Awareness, conflict and ego have died,
It is the inner-understanding, strife and ego which have died.
RRL4: but the One who sees does not die. ||2||
He, Who is the seer, dies not.
U8J0: For the sake of it, you journey to sacred shrines and holy rivers;
The reason you goest to the banks of the holy streams,
GHVA: but this priceless jewel is within your own heart.
that invaluable jewel is in your mind.
K80N: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read endlessly; they stir up arguments and controversies,
The Brahmans continue to read, discuss and enter into controversies,
S4MY: but they do not know the secret deep within. ||3||
but understand not the thing, which is within.
PP7A: I have not died - that evil nature within me has died.
I have not died, rather my calamitous ignorance is dead.
VNYA: The One who is pervading everywhere does not die.
He, who is every where contained, dies not.
UZ95: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed God to me,
Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed to me the pervading Lord,
W8BL: and now I see that there is no such thing as birth or death. ||4||4||
and now, none seems me to die or to be born.
XFNP: I am forever a sacrifice to the one who listens and hears,
One who continually hears, understands, and believes in God's Name,
YNAT: Who understands and believes in the Name.
I am forever a sacrifice to him.
3ZU2: When the Lord Himself leads us astray, there is no other place of rest for us to find.
When the lord himself strayest, the mortal finds no place or abode.
HBK4: You impart understanding, and You unite us in Your Union. ||1||
You impartest understanding, and unitest with Your union.
XEBS: I obtain the Naam, which shall go along with me in the end.
May I obtain the Name, which shall go with me.
6SWB: Without the Name, all are held in the grip of Death. ||1||Pause||
Without God's Name, all are chained by death. Pause.
SUFF: My farming and my trading are by the Support of the Name.
My cultivation and trade lie in the support of Lord's Name.
8EGX: The seeds of sin and virtue are bound together.
Of the seed of sin and virtue the mortal is the bundle.
Y9KX: Sexual desire and anger are the wounds of the soul.
Lust and wrath are the wounds in the mind.
04J6: The evil-minded ones forget the Naam, and then depart. ||2||
The evil-minded forget God's Name and depart.
XE3Q: True are the Teachings of the True Guru.
True is the instruction of the True Guru.
WRUB: The body and mind are cooled and soothed, by the touchstone of Truth.
By knowing the real worth of the True Name, the body and mind become cool.
L2GA: This is the true mark of wisdom: that one remains detached, like the water-lily, or the lotus upon the water.
The test of the Guru-ward is this, that in the world, he remains detached like the water-lily in water, or the lotus in water.
GKMZ: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, one becomes sweet, like the juice of the sugar cane. ||3||
Imbued with God's Name, he is sweet like the juice of sugarcane.
SWB2: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the castle of the body has ten gates.
On the receipt of the order of God the body castle, with ten gates, came into existence.
6EN2: The five passions dwell there, together with the Divine Light of the Infinite.
Therein abide the five evil passions, together with the infinite Divine light.
MAJZ: The Lord Himself is the merchandise, and He Himself is the trader.
The Lord Himself is the weighable merchandise and Himself the merchant.
FH9Z: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are adorned and rejuvenated. ||4||5||
Nanak God's Name is man's regenerator.
0LXP: How can we know where we came from?
Can it be known, whence the man has come?
FLBV: Where did we originate, and where will we go and merge?
Where has he sprung from and whither does he go and merge?
BSV7: How are we bound, and how do we obtain liberation?
How is he bound down, and how does he obtain emancipation?
FMPW: How do we merge with intuitive ease into the Eternal, Imperishable Lord? ||1||
How is he easily absorbed in the Imperishable Lord?
H5PT: With the Naam in the heart and the Ambrosial Naam on our lips,
He, who has the Name in his heart, the Name Nectar in his mouth, and remembers the Name of Lord,
G560: through the Name of the Lord, we rise above desire, like the Lord. ||1||Pause||
in Man-lion form, becomes desire-free, like God. Pause.
HS0S: With intuitive ease we come, and with intuitive ease we depart.
Subject to natural law the man comes, and subject to the natural law he departs.
4YS8: From the mind we originate, and into the mind we are absorbed.
From mind's desires he is sprung, and in mind's desires he is absorbed.
Y9FJ: As Gurmukh, we are liberated, and are not bound.
The Guru-ward is emancipated and falls not into entanglements.
DWTC: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated through the Name of the Lord. ||2||
He ponders over the Divine word, and is delivered through God's Name.
KKGN: At night, lots of birds settle on the tree.
Many birds settle on a tree by night.
09W1: Some are happy, and some are sad. Caught in the desires of the mind, they perish.
Some are happy and some unhappy. Through mind's allurement they all perish.
62TJ: And when the life-night comes to its end, then they look to the sky.
When the night passes away, they look to the sky.
2N8B: They fly away in all ten directions, according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||3||
In ten directions they fly according to the recorded destiny.

QRRZ: Those who are committed to the Naam, see the world as merely a temporary pasture.
They, who are associated with the Name, seem the world a temporary but in pastureland.
VJZL: Sexual desire and anger are broken, like a jar of poison.
The poisonous pitcher of lust and wrath, at last bursts.
R1TM: Without the merchandise of the Name, the house of the body and the store of the mind are empty.
Without the merchandise of the Name, the body-house and the mind-shop are empty.
BZEM: Meeting the Guru, the hard and heavy doors are opened. ||4||
By meeting the Guru, the adamant shutters are opened.
EG24: One meets the Holy Saint only through perfect destiny.
The saint is met through primal destiny.
UU2T: The Lord's perfect people rejoice in the Truth.
Lord's perfect people rejoice in Truth.
YQEL: Surrendering their minds and bodies, they find the Lord with intuitive ease.
Who automatically obtain their Lord by surrendering their soul and body,
ACK1: Nanak falls at the feet of those.
UCWV: The conscious mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya.
In lust, wrath and wealth, your mind is engrossed.
2L62: The conscious mind is awake only to falsehood, corruption and attachment.
On account of secular love in your mind, you are awake in falsehood and sin.
DRNT: It gathers in the assets of sin and greed.
You have amassed the capital of vice and greed.
DZ0P: So swim across the river of life, O my mind, with the Sacred Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
With the immaculate Name O my mind, do you swim across the life-stream.
JFUM: Waaho! Waaho! - Great! Great is my True Lord! I seek Your All-powerful Support.
Wonderous, blest you are, O my True Lord. I have but Yours support.
FD3B: I am a sinner - You alone are pure. ||1||Pause||
I am a sinner, You alone are pure. Pause.
25WD: Fire and water join together, and the breath roars in its fury!
Because of fire and water, the breath roars loudly.
12SF: The tongue and the sex organs each seek to taste.
The tongue and the sexual organ each enjoys a relish.
HBZN: The eyes which look upon corruption do not know the Love and the Fear of God.
The evil-eyed possess not the fear and love of God.
QJE6: Conquering self-conceit, one obtains the Name. ||2||
If man effaces his self-conceit, he obtains the Name, then.
W69L: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, shall never again have to die.
He, who dies through Gurbani, dies not again.
XWV8: Without such a death, how can one attain perfection?
Without such death, how can man attain perfection.
X76X: The mind is engrossed in deception, treachery and duality.
The mind is engrossed in the expansion and duality.
2BYV: Whatever the Immortal Lord does, comes to pass. ||3||
Whatever the Immortal Lord does that comes to pass.
TX55: So get aboard that boat when your turn comes.
I shall board the ship, when my turn comes.
WCH3: Those who fail to embark upon that boat shall be beaten in the Court of the Lord.
They, who are stopped from embarking upon the ship shall be thrashed in Lord's court.
MUS9: Blessed is that Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, where the Praises of the True Lord are sung.
Blest, is the court of the Guru, where the praises of the True Lord are sung.
3646: O Nanak, the One Creator Lord is pervading hearth and home. ||4||7||
Nanak, the unique Lord is pervading heart and home.
TQFY: The inverted heart-lotus has been turned upright, through reflective meditation on God.
The inverted lotus has turned upwards through Lord's meditation,
X2M4: From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.
From the tenth-gate firmament, the nectar-line has commenced to trickle.
WWTP: The Lord Himself is pervading the three worlds. ||1||
God, the Enemy of pride, is pervading the three worlds, Himself.
NUZS: O my mind, do not give in to doubt.
O my mind, entertain not any doubt.
XRQN: When the mind surrenders to the Name, it drinks in the essence of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
By mind's propitiation, the Name's immortalising Nectar is quaffed. Pause.
UV5V: So win the game of life; let your mind surrender and accept death.
Win your life game, O man and accept in your mind, the truth of death.
01TX: When the self dies, the individual mind comes to know the Supreme Mind.
When self is effaced, the Supreme Soul is comprehended in the mind itself.
KNXF: As the inner vision is awakened, one comes to know one's own home, deep within the self. ||2||
By the dawning of God's Grace, man comes to recognise His mansion, from within his home.
YLW2: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is austerity, chastity and cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
God's Name is the true continence, chastity and ablution at the places of pilgrimage.
W79E: Of what avail is it to make extensive ostentation?
T714: The All-pervading Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||
The Omnipresent Lord is the Knower of the hearts of men.
26XZ: If I had faith in someone else, then I would go to that one's house.
If I have faith in another, then, I would go to another's house.
KBYT: But where should I go, to beg? There is no other place for me.
Whom should I beg? For me there is no other place.
ER0H: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||4||8||
Nanak, by Guru's instruction, I am absorbed in the Supreme Lord,
G093: Meeting the True Guru, we are shown the way to die.
When the true Guru meets, he shows the way to die in life.
38T7: Remaining alive in this death brings joy deep within.
The joy of remaining alive, after such a death, is pleasing to my mind.
MULQ: Overcoming egotistical pride, the Tenth Gate is found. ||1||
Having abrogated my ego, I have reached the tenth gate.
6NAH: Death is pre-ordained - no one who comes can remain here.
Getting recorded the time of death, men did come into the world, and cannot stay longer.
D9N2: So chant and meditate on the Lord, and remain in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
They should, therefore, embrace God's meditation and abide in God's sanctuary. Pause.
GSF4: Meeting the True Guru, duality is dispelled.
When the true Guru meets, then does duality take to heels.
TBCV: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mind is attached to the Lord God.
The heart lotus blooms, and the mind gets attached to the Lord God.
YFPU: One who remains dead while yet alive obtains the greatest happiness hereafter. ||2||
He, who remains dead in life obtains Supreme bliss hereafter.
MBXJ: Meeting the True Guru, one becomes truthful, chaste and pure.
By meeting the true Guru, one becomes truthful, abstinent, and pure.
WU1U: Climbing up the steps of the Guru's Path, one becomes the highest of the high.
By walking in Guru's way man becomes the highest of the high.
QB2R: When the Lord grants His Mercy, the fear of death is conquered. ||3||
By being endowed with Lord's grace, the fear of death is destroyed,
P30P: Uniting in Guru's Union, we are absorbed in His Loving Embrace.
By uniting to Guru's union, mortal sinks into Lord's lap.
QHLW: Granting His Grace, He reveals the Mansion of His Presence, within the home of the self.
Showing his mercy, the Guru reveals Lord's mansion, within man's own house.
LQ9H: O Nanak, conquering egotism, we are absorbed into the Lord. ||4||9||
Nanak, effacing his ego, the Guru unites man with the Master.

42GT: What do we know of what will happen hereafter?
What do I know what shall befall me hereafter?
PN9B: Whatever pleases Him shall come to pass.
Whatever is His will, that comes to pass.
8NRB: There is no other Doer except Him. ||1||
Without God there is no other doer.
VR7S: I do not know about karma, or how great Your gifts are.
I know not how great is Your bounty, and how great is Yours gift!
665L: The karma of actions, the Dharma of righteousness, social class and status, are contained within Your Name. ||1||Pause||
Good actions, religion and high caste are contained in Your Name, O Lord. Pause.
VFYT: You are So Great, O Giver, O Great Giver!
You are so great the donor and Giver,
CS8H: The treasure of Your devotional worship is never exhausted.
that Yours treasures of meditation run not short.
MM2T: One who takes pride in himself shall never be right.
It is never right to take pride.
2X3G: The soul and body are all at Your disposal. ||2||
Man's life and body are all at Your disposal.
LSGF: You kill and rejuvenate. You forgive and merge us into Yourself.
You takest and givest life, and forgiving unitest the mortal with You.
GEXY: As it pleases You, You inspire us to chant Your Name.
As is Your will, so do You cause me to remember Your Name,
XKS7: You are All-knowing, All-seeing and True, O my Supreme Lord.
You are all-Wise, All-seeing, and All-true, O my over Lord,
Q1HF: Please, bless me with the Guru's Teachings; my faith is in You alone. ||3||
Grant to me Guru's instruction, my faith is in You.
JBCG: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord, has no pollution in his body.
He, whose mind is imbued with the love of the Lord, has no filth in his body.
C416: Through the Guru's Word, the True Shabad is realized.
By Guru's words, the true Lord is recognised.
7Z62: All Power is Yours, through the greatness of Your Name.
My might is in You and my greatness in Your Name.
07P9: Nanak abides in the Sanctuary of Your devotees. ||4||10||
Nanak abides in the sanctuary of Yours devotees.
NKBL: Those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar.
He, who utters the unutterable God, and quaffs Nectar,
3E1P: Other fears are forgotten, and they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
forgets other fears, and gets absorbed in Lord's Name.
MNNY: Why should we fear, when fear is dispelled by the Fear of God?
Why should we fear, when all the fears sink in Lord's fear?
9VNX: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, I recognize God. ||1||Pause||
Through the instruction of perfect Guru I have recognised the Master. Pause
0CEA: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's essence are blessed and acclaimed,
Within whose mind has the capital of the Omnipresent God's Name,
HDLS: And intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||2||
is blessed automatically with natural ease.
N5LC: Those whom the Lord puts to sleep, evening and morning
The wayward, whom the Lord puts to slumber, evening and morning,
ED4A: - those self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged by Death, here and hereafter. ||3||
are bound to death here and hereafter.
RA8C: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, day and night, are perfect.
They in whose heart, and night abides the Pervading God, are perfect.
S4RD: O Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away. ||4||11||
Nanak, they cast off their doubt, and blend with the Lord.
AR9A: One who loves the three qualities is subject to birth and death.
He who loves the three qualities continues coming and going.
8UGW: The four Vedas speak only of the visible forms.
The four Vedas describe only the visible Forms.
5517: They describe and explain the three states of mind,
They explain and expound the three mental states.
1QT4: but the fourth state, union with the Lord, is known only through the True Guru. ||1||
The fourth state of communion with the Lord, is known through the Divine True Guru.
X6WW: Through devotional worship of the Lord, and service to the Guru, one swims across.
Through Lord's meditation, and Guru's service, the mortal swims across.
JBAF: Then, one is not born again, and is not subject to death. ||1||Pause||
Again, he is not born and he dies not. Pause.
TQJK: Everyone speaks of the four great blessings;
Everyone talks of the four cardinal boons,
258S: the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Pandits speak of them as well.
twenty-seven Simritis, six Shashtras, and the leading pandits speak of them as well,
KMM5: But without the Guru, they do not understand their true significance.
Without the Guru none gets at their meaning and real significance.
H8AT: The treasure of liberation is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||2||
The wealth of salvation is obtained by the devotional service of god.
DX6X: Those, within whose hearts the Lord dwells,
Within whose mind that God abides,
5WZ0: become Gurmukh; they receive the blessings of devotional worship.
Through the Guru, he obtains His meditations.
2ZF1: Through devotional worship of the Lord, liberation and bliss are obtained.
By God's worship, emancipation and celestial bliss are procured.
3PRX: Through the Guru's Teachings, supreme ecstasy is obtained. ||3||
By Guru's instruction supreme happiness is obtained.
6RBQ: One who meets the Guru, beholds Him, and inspires others to behold Him as well.
He, who has met the Guru, himself beholds God, and causes others to behold Him.
5MZZ: In the midst of hope, the Guru teaches us to live above hope and desire.
Among hopes, the Guru has instructed him to remain without hope.
Z9XA: He is the Master of the meek, the Giver of peace to all.
He is the Master of the meek, and the Giver of peace to all.
P444: Nanak's mind is imbued with the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||12||
Nanak's mind is imbued with the love of God's feet.
TENJ: With your nectar-like body, you live in comfort, but this world is just a passing drama.
O body, thinking yourself immortal you livest in peace, but this world is a play,
19QG: You practice greed, avarice and great falsehood, and you carry such a heavy burden.
You practisest avarice covetousness, great, false-hood, and carriest many, burdens.
HBKE: O body, I have seen you blowing away like dust on the earth. ||1||
O body! I have seen, you, wallowing like ashes on the earth.
0Q7R: Only the good deeds which you have done shall remain with you, O my soul. This opportunity shall not come again! ||1||Pause||
The good deeds done shall abide with you, O my soul, you shall not, again find such opportunity. Pause.

UJLH: I say to you, O my body: listen to my advice!
I say to you, O my body. Listen carefully to my advice.
PVUT: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip.
You slanderest, and praisest others and indulgest in false backbiting,
AREG: You gaze upon the wives of others, O my soul; you steal and commit evil deeds.
You, O mind, beholdest another's vine (women) and committest theft and evil deeds.
RKX4: But when the swan departs, you shall remain behind, like an abandoned woman. ||2||
When the soul swan departs, you remainest behind, and becomest like an abandoned woman.
5RAX: O body, you are living in a dream! What good deeds have you done?
You, O body abidest as if in a dream. What good deed have you done?
CQBN: When I stole something by deception, then my mind was pleased.
When I took something by stealth, it was then pleasing to the mind.
GKNC: I have no honor in this world, and I shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. My life has been lost, wasted in vain! ||3||
I have no honour in this world, and shall have no shelter in the world beyond. I have lost my human life in vain.
GALY: I am totally miserable! O Baba Nanak, no one cares for me at all! ||1||Pause||
I have become very miserable, O father, Nanak and none cares for me. Pause.
3BKK: Turkish horses, gold, silver and loads of gorgeous clothes
The Turkish steed, gold, silver and loads of raiment,
3G8K: - none of these shall go with you, O Nanak. They are lost and left behind, you fool!
Accompany not any one, O Nanak. They are left behind in this World, O fool.
5ZJ9: I have tasted all the sugar candy and sweets, but Your Name alone is Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||
